title: Sultanate economy: more taxes, trade, coins, society

boxes.title: Taxes: added detail
items: Kharaj varies **1/10** to **1/2** by crop, region
Khams: sharia = state **1/5**, soldiers ==**4/5**==; also treasure-troves
Charai: on milch cattle, sheep; haq-i-sharb paid by canal-water users

boxes.title: Agriculture & crafts: more
items: Crops: wheat, barley, gram, rice, sugarcane, cotton, oilseeds
Paper strengthened record-keeping; also **glass-making**, better looms
Textiles, carpets, leather, metal-work; ==**sericulture**== cut raw silk imports
